stories.headline: Milwaukee win the World Series for the first time
stories.summary: Baseball's World Series ended in five games. The Milwaukee Brewers beat the Tampa Bay Rays, closing the series out 4–1 in Game 5 for the first title in the club's history. Their catcher, William Contreras, was named the series' most valuable player.

stories.headline: DoorDash agrees to buy Instacart for $17 billion
stories.summary: DoorDash has announced plans to buy the grocery delivery company Instacart in a deal worth $17 billion. That works out at $65 per share, and it would give Instacart customers access to more than 50,000 additional stores. The companies expect to finalise it in late 2027 or early 2028.

stories.headline: Canada takes a stake in the AI company Cohere
stories.summary: Canada's federal government is investing up to C$1.6 billion, about US$1.1 billion, in the Toronto-based artificial intelligence company Cohere. It takes an equity stake as part of a C$7 billion funding round. The money is intended to expand domestic computing infrastructure and AI development.

stories.headline: An elephant tooth reopens a lost prehistoric world
stories.summary: A single ancient elephant tooth found in northern Israel has helped researchers reconstruct a surprisingly lush landscape of nearly 700,000 years ago. The fossil belonged to Palaeoloxodon antiquus, commonly known as the straight-tusked elephant. It lay alongside basalt handaxes and cleavers left by early humans.
